description: Ground-truth user interest profiles. Each profile defines a topic_distribution used to sample that user's posts. Recovery experiments should try to rediscover profile_id / distribution from posts alone.

ai_coding_innovations.label: AI innovations in coding
ai_coding_innovations.description: Posts about AI tools improving software development, coding assistants, and engineering productivity.

ai_copyright_theft.label: AI theft of artistic and authors' copyrights
ai_copyright_theft.description: Posts about generative AI copying artists/writers without consent or compensation.

ai_mass_surveillance.label: AI-enabled mass surveillance
ai_mass_surveillance.description: Posts about facial recognition, predictive policing, and AI monitoring of populations.

coding_heavy.label: Mostly AI coding innovations
coding_heavy.description: Dominantly posts about AI coding tools; rare other topics.

copyright_heavy.label: Mostly AI copyright / theft concerns
copyright_heavy.description: Dominantly posts about generative-AI copyright theft.

balanced.label: Even across all topics
balanced.description: Posts roughly evenly about all three topics.

coding_copyright.label: Split: coding + copyright
coding_copyright.description: Cares about coding and copyright; rarely surveillance.

coding_surveillance.label: Split: coding + surveillance
coding_surveillance.description: Cares about coding and surveillance; rarely copyright.

copyright_surveillance.label: Split: copyright + surveillance
copyright_surveillance.description: Cares about copyright and surveillance; rarely coding.
